configurations.name: Open Admin UI: SB1 in VS Code
configurations.command: zsh -lc 'for i in {1..40}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 1 http://127.0.0.1:5050/api/health 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 0.25; done; for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:5050 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 0.25; done; open http://127.0.0.1:5050'
configurations.preLaunchTask: Start Inventory Admin UI Server: SB1
